links.outcome: Intention-to-use AI before vs after 30-min educational presentation
links.effect: Among 30 respondents, intention-to-use AI rose from 5.37 (±1.81) to 5.83 (±1.64), not statistically significant; blockchain intention rose significantly from 4.30 to 5.90 (p < 0.01).
links.quote: In this sub-group, the mean intention-to-use AI was 5.37 (±1.81) before the session and 5.83 (±1.64) afterwards, which did not show a statistically significant change.

links.outcome: Intention-to-use AI in breast cancer care after a 30-minute educational presentation
links.effect: Among 30 post-education respondents, mean intention-to-use AI increased from 5.37 (±1.81) to 5.83 (±1.64) on a 7-point Likert scale; the change was not statistically significant.
links.quote: In this sub-group, the mean intention-to-use AI was 5.37 (±1.81) before the session and 5.83 (±1.64) afterwards, which did not show a statistically significant change.
